content: .{@-गु, -गू@} {%a.%} [अधि-गम्-कू-डित् ऊङादेशो वा] of irresistible motion or course (अधृतगमन), impetuous; यदभ्रिगावो अंध्रिगू इदा चिदह्नो अश्विना <ls>Rv. 8. 22. 11</ls> also तुभ्यं श्चोतन्ति अध्रिगो <ls>Ait. Br. 2. 12</ls>.

.{@-गुः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a heavenly killer of sacrificial victims, or the name formula itself ending with an invocation of Agni. -ज {%a.%} [अध्रिं जनयति, जन्-ड] making irresistible. इति चिन्मन्युमध्रिजः <ls>Rv. 5. 7. 10</ls>.
